  ADMIN_EMAILS: z.string().optional(),

rootSection:
## Admin extension

Installed by `bun run shibumi add admin` (needs the auth extension); full guide in `agents/admin.md`.

- Server-rendered panel at `/admin` (`src/routes/admin.ts`); authorization and read models in `src/lib/admin.ts`; styles in `public/admin.css`.
- Admins are the emails in `ADMIN_EMAILS` (comma-separated, case-insensitive), validated in `src/env.ts`. Empty means no admins and `/admin` is locked.
- `GET /admin` lists users; `POST /admin/users/:id/delete` deletes one (CSRF-protected, cascades via foreign keys, refuses self-delete). Signed-out visitors get 401, non-admins 403.
- No new tables. Deleting a user does not sweep upload blobs; the uploads extension owns that.
- Removal deletes code and reverses edits; remove admin before auth.
removeNote: Remove admin before auth (admin depends on it). Remove the ADMIN_EMAILS variable from the environment when no longer needed.
